name: Tirokafteri
steps: Drain the roasted pepper thoroughly and chop the hot chilli, removing some seeds if a milder dip is wanted.
Crumble feta into a processor with yogurt, pepper, chilli and lemon juice. Pulse briefly so the dip is thick and slightly textured.
Drizzle in most of the olive oil while pulsing once or twice; taste before adding salt because feta usually provides enough.
Spoon into a shallow bowl, scatter oregano and drizzle the remaining oil over the surface. Chill briefly and serve with bread or vegetables.
tips: Drain the pepper well; excess liquid turns this thick feta spread into a runny sauce.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
